author: "Vy Nguyen"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  run_name:          "HGM_study"
  output_dir:        "output"
  prevalence_cutoff: 0.70    # minimum fraction of samples a species must appear in
  abundance_cutoff:  0.10    # minimum relative abundance (%) to count as present
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

run_name          <- params$run_name
output_dir        <- params$output_dir
prevalence_cutoff <- params$prevalence_cutoff
abundance_cutoff  <- params$abundance_cutoff
prefix            <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Prevalence cutoff:", prevalence_cutoff,
    "| Abundance cutoff:", abundance_cutoff, "%\n")
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
dat          <- read_excel(here("data", "species_abundance.xlsx"),
                           sheet = "species_relabund")
species_names <- dat[[1]]
abundance_mat <- as.matrix(dat[, -1])
sample_names  <- colnames(abundance_mat)

cat("Species:", nrow(dat), "| Samples:", ncol(abundance_mat), "\n")
```

## 2. Core Species Identification

```{r core-species}
# Presence/absence matrix at given abundance cutoff
presence_mat <- (abundance_mat >= abundance_cutoff) * 1

# Prevalence per species
prevalence       <- rowMeans(presence_mat)
prevalence_table <- data.frame(Species    = species_names,
                                Prevalence = round(prevalence, 3))

# Core species: prevalence >= cutoff, exclude unclassified
core_idx        <- which(prevalence >= prevalence_cutoff)
core_species    <- species_names[core_idx]
core_species    <- core_species[!grepl("unclassified", core_species, ignore.case = TRUE)]
core_prevalence <- prevalence[match(core_species, species_names)]
core_table      <- data.frame(Species    = core_species,
                               Prevalence = round(core_prevalence, 3)) %>%
                   arrange(desc(Prevalence))

cat("Core species identified:", nrow(core_table), "\n")
print(core_table)

# Export
write.xlsx(list(
  Abundance_Matrix    = data.frame(Species = species_names, abundance_mat),
  Presence_Absence    = data.frame(Species = species_names, presence_mat),
  Prevalence_All      = prevalence_table,
  Core_Species        = core_table
), file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "core_microbiome_tables.xlsx")))
```

## 3. Boxplot — Core Species Abundance Distribution

```{r boxplot-core, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Filter to core species only
core_data <- dat %>%
  filter(!!sym(names(dat)[1]) %in% core_table$Species)

core_long <- core_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-1, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Species = 1)

core_long$Species <- factor(core_long$Species, 
                            levels = core_table$Species)

# Summary statistics per species
core_wide <- core_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Abundance)
writexl::write_xlsx(core_wide, path = file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "boxplot_core_wide.xlsx")))

summary_core <- core_long %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean       = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median     = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD         = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prevalence = core_table$Prevalence[match(first(as.character(Species)),
                                             core_table$Species)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write.xlsx(summary_core,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "core_species_summary.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

# Horizontal boxplot (log10 scale)
p_box <- ggplot(core_long, aes(x = Abundance, y = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#98c8e2", color = "#1c5d81",
               outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.13, size = 1,
              color = "gray30", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100),
                labels = c("0.01", "0.10", "1.00", "10.00", "100.00")) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(core_long$Species))) +
  labs(x     = "Relative Abundance (%) [log10 scale]",
       y     = "Species",
       title = "Distribution of Core Gut Microbiome Species") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic")
  )

print(p_box)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "core_microbiome_boxplot.png")),
       p_box, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## 4. Stability Analysis — Threshold Sensitivity

```{r stability-single, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# Show how core species count changes with prevalence threshold
thresholds  <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.01)
core_counts <- sapply(thresholds, function(th) {
  candidates <- species_names[prevalence >= th]
  sum(!grepl("unclassified", candidates, ignore.case = TRUE))
})

stability_df <- data.frame(Threshold = thresholds, CoreCount = core_counts)

p_stab <- ggplot(stability_df, aes(x = Threshold, y = CoreCount)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#e74c3c", size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = prevalence_cutoff,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = prevalence_cutoff, y = max(core_counts) * 0.8,
           label = paste0("Cutoff: ", prevalence_cutoff),
           color = "blue", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title    = "Core Microbiome Stability",
       subtitle = "Number of core species vs prevalence threshold",
       x = "Prevalence Threshold", y = "Number of Core Species") +
  theme_bw()

print(p_stab)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "stability_prevalence.png")),
       p_stab, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r stability-2d, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
# Cross-tabulate over both abundance and prevalence thresholds
ab_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0)
prev_thresholds <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)

stability_2d <- bind_rows(lapply(ab_cutoffs, function(ab) {
  pres <- if (ab == 0) (abundance_mat > 0) * 1 else (abundance_mat >= ab) * 1
  prev <- rowMeans(pres)
  counts <- sapply(prev_thresholds, function(p) {
    cands <- species_names[prev >= p]
    sum(!grepl("unclassified", cands, ignore.case = TRUE))
  })
  data.frame(PrevThreshold  = prev_thresholds,
             CoreCount       = counts,
             AbundanceCutoff = paste0("≥", ab, "%"))
})) %>%
  mutate(AbundanceCutoff = factor(AbundanceCutoff,
                                  levels = paste0("≥", ab_cutoffs, "%")))

p_stab2d <- ggplot(stability_2d,
                   aes(x = PrevThreshold, y = CoreCount, color = AbundanceCutoff)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(title    = "Core Microbiome Stability — Sensitivity Analysis",
       subtitle = "Effect of abundance and prevalence filters on core species count",
       x = "Prevalence Threshold", y = "Number of Core Species",
       color = "Min Abundance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "gray"))

print(p_stab2d)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "stability_2d.png")),
       p_stab2d, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

write.xlsx(list(
  Stability_Long  = stability_2d,
  Stability_Wide  = stability_2d %>%
                    pivot_wider(names_from = AbundanceCutoff, values_from = CoreCount)
), file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "stability_sensitivity.xlsx")))
```
